What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?

examples.knowledge_point: Identifying the Vertex of a Horizontal Parabola Given Its Graph
examples.problem:
What are the coordinates of the vertex of the parabola shown below?

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/527ab20a54cc8191b5ef618d99601e77ca2ef4e757ee5f83ddf4c868bf0e5b15.png)
examples.worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/bfb2b1ce3cccea8a22732a061dd8ace5ad1b3c808feb5c1ec074802f7daf4d1a.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-4,2).$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/b806a24c0427da4979d8452077dfed49b4bc7af67e25eb098e4f4a71c53af874.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
feedback.worked_solution:
The vertex of an upward-opening parabola is the lowest point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/fb45cb414b838d2671a5757c25a3f05d80f53f3972fcb7355353c7b210d0907d.png)

  

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(-2,4).$
